subject: Two 25-game runs of the reasoning-carry arm, byte-identical bundle. Run 1 was completed 2026-08-29 and never read; run 2 was pushed today as the replicate.
mechanism: tool_agent.py:2267 stores the model's thinking under assistant_message['reasoning']; the model's chat_template.jinja reads message.reasoning_content and defaults to ''. Every prior turn was therefore sent with an EMPTY <think> block, discarding 96% of everything the model writes (mean thinking 5,779 chars vs 232 chars of visible text over 386 responses). The overlay exposes the last 2 assistant turns' thinking under the key the template actually reads, at _chat_completion, on copies.
mechanism_live_in_the_shipped_bytes: arc3-q38-rcarry-v1/src/ARC3-Inference/inference/agent/tool_agent.py: _carry_reasoning at 1494, call site at 1535, REASONING_CARRY_TURNS=2 and REASONING_CARRY_MAX_CHARS=6000 in setup_commands.json. Confirmed in both run logs.
single_point_trap_check: PASSES. In run 2, 12 games gained and 4 lost against the base; the largest single game (sb26, +3) is 27% of the net +11. ex-ft09 (9.001) moves with mean25 (10.452), so ft09 is not carrying it.

mechanism_signature_both_runs.prediction: retained reasoning stops re-derivation, so tokens per action FALL and actions per game RISE
mechanism_signature_both_runs.consistency: both runs move the predicted way, and the run with the LARGER signature is the run with the LARGER level gain. n=2, so this is suggestive, not a dose-response.
mechanism_signature_both_runs.IT_IS_NOT_EVIDENCE_ON_ITS_OWN: byte-identical reruns move tokens per action by 3.9% to 14.0% (solution/analysis/token_efficiency_null.py). Run 1's -10.2% is inside that null; run 2's -19.2% is outside it. Do not gate on this counter.

external_corroboration: OpenAI, 2026-07-29: GPT-5.6 Sol 13.3% -> 38.3% on the ARC-AGI-3 PUBLIC set with no weight change, from RETAINED REASONING plus COMPACTION, at ~6x fewer output tokens. Retained reasoning is exactly this mechanism. Measured on a closed frontier model at a 13.3% baseline, so it raises the prior; it does not prove the effect here.
honest_limits: 31 then 46 levels on byte-identical bytes. Single-run sd on this bench is 3.6 to 7.5 levels; the pooled SE at n=2 is about 5. The pooled +3.5 is roughly 0.7 sigma and is NOT significant.
Run 1's paired sign was -1 and run 2's was +7. They disagree in sign.

The fitted bench-to-board map puts pooled rcarry at board 2.43 (on levels) to 2.62 (on mean25), which is a TIE with D-undo's 2.66 posterior, not an improvement. Pooled mean25 7.801 is above the fit's calibration range (max 7.151), so that prediction is an extrapolation.
No predeclared gate existed for this arm; the defect record of 2026-08-27 declared no bands. This is a measured promotion, not a pre-registered one.

decision.framing: EARNS DRAWS under CLAUDE.md rule 15(b), explicitly NOT a significance claim. A verified repair of a code path that was silently discarding 96% of model output, pooled ABOVE the control family on all three outcome statistics across two runs, with no measured regression, clears the ~21% prior a max-keeping board requires by a wide margin.
decision.action: add as a THIRD rotation config alongside D-undo and K-topk100 rather than replacing either. Retiring a config on this evidence would be the 2026-09-07 arm-AE mistake in reverse.
decision.retire_if: after 6 draws its observed board mean is more than 0.40 below the best other config.
decision.next_experiment: COMPACTION, the untested half of the OpenAI result. _trim_messages_for_context (tool_agent.py:2035) does exactly the rolling truncation they name as the defect, and raising that same budget was our single largest measured win (33 levels vs 23). Argue against arm AB first: AB carried a summary ACROSS level resets and game_over, i.e. it added STALE information; compaction preserves information inside a level that is about to be destroyed. Different mechanism, and the distinction must be stated in the predeclared gate.
